title: HB1340 (2025 Regular): Machine gun conversion; provide an affirmative defense.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2025/html/HB/1300-1399/HB1340IN.htm)
provenance.note: Introduced text (as filed), no date. The clause 'and who is not otherwise authorized by federal law to manufacture, possess or use a machine gun conversion device' is struck from subsection (1)(a) and moved into a new affirmative defense in (2)(b). No passage vote recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (Miss. Code § 97-37-39): Any person who manufactures, possesses, or uses a machine gun conversion device shall be guilty of a felony. Any person convicted of a first offense in violation of this act shall be guilty of a felony, and shall be sentenced to imprisonment for a term of not more than ten (10) years, fined not more than Ten Thousand Dollars ($10,000.00), or both. It shall be an affirmative defense for a violation of this section that the person is otherwise authorized by federal law to manufacture, possess or use a machine gun conversion device. A person convicted of a second or subsequent offense shall be charged with a felony under this act and shall be sentenced to imprisonment for a term of not more than fifteen (15) years, fined not more than Twenty Thousand Dollars ($20,000.00), or both.
